name: agent.run
doc: Run a spec in a supervised interactive session on the named engine. Submit declared step outputs before the session ends; pass session to resume in the same directory. Codex model is sol (default) or astra and effort defaults to high; Claude always runs Opus; Devin defaults to swe-2-high and model "fusion" runs Fusion (Claude Opus 5.5 High + SWE-2 Medium).
